research_topic: Improve zero-shot to few-shot performance gaps in cross-domain scenarios through meta-learning frameworks for 3-7B parameter vision-language models regarding transfer capability enhancement across domain boundaries, evaluated on cross-domain few-shot benchmarks including visual question answering, image classification, and multimodal reasoning tasks with 1-16 shot demonstrations, addressing the 2025 research challenge where larger models show increasing zero-shot versus few-shot performance discrepancies by developing adaptive demonstration selection and context optimization strategies for improved generalization.
